body: Multilingual LLMs show stereotype-related behavior that varies across languages, but behavioral scores do not show where the relevant information is represented or how it affects the output. To investigate these internal mechanisms, we compare linear probing, attribution patching, sparse autoencoders (SAEs) and feature ablation in Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-2-9B. Probe performance peaks substantially earlier than attribution in all three models, with a separation of 36-53% of model depth. Retained Llama-Scope features often match the social category on which they were selected and form recurring semantic families, but their lexical alignment and ablation effects vary across SAE suites. Only 6-18% of evaluated residual-stream features have language-agnostic effects under our criterion, and none are category-agnostic. Language-agnostic features have larger mean ablation effects in Llama-Scope, but this pattern does not repeat in the other SAE suites. Decodability, output influence, and cross-lingual ablation effects therefore need to be measured separately.
summaryZh: 该研究深入探究了多语言大模型中刻板印象的内部机制，通过比较线性探测、归因修复、稀疏自编码器（SAEs）和特征消融等技术，在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B和Gemma-2-9B模型上分析了刻板印象信息在模型中的表示位置及其对输出的影响。研究发现，探测性能峰值远早于归因，且大部分残差流特征的效果具有语言依赖性。该研究揭示了不同模型在处理跨语言刻板印象时的差异，并强调了分别衡量解码性、输出影响和跨语言消融效应的重要性，为理解和减轻多语言模型中的偏见提供了新的分析工具和见解。
